text:
This is a small side salad of mixed greens with a light dressing, on a square plate about 24 cm across. The greens cover roughly 10 by 8 cm and are loosely piled. I estimate about 45 g of leaves plus a little dressing, so around 50 g total. Greens are very low in energy, and a teaspoon or two of oil dressing adds perhaps 40 kcal, so the total is about 50 kcal.
